subject: Re: coffee table visit
text: Following up on your note, I’d still like to stop by this Sunday afternoon, but the old laptop charger failed and the replacement pushed an unexpected expense onto this week’s budget. That means I can’t bring the extra tools I mentioned, and I’d rather not spend money on the coffee table we discussed. If you’re open to it, we can keep the visit short and practical: I can drop off the spare curtain rod around two, help test the wall anchor, and leave by four. If that feels too rushed, Wednesday evening after five still works better for me because I’ll have more time after a client call. Let me know which day suits you, and I’ll bring only what I already have.
